title: The step-by-step, judge and retrieval sets: episodes of walks, moves and jobs; judgments by people, tests and measurements; searches with what was offered
request: M6 episodes, M7 judged examples and M8 retrieval examples from the shaped records.
plan: Episodes from walks, graph moves and jobs.
Judgments from corrections, fixes, G4 and refused moves.
Retrievals from tool searches and the search log.

decisions.decision: A candidate judged by its own maker with no other evidence never enters.
decisions.why: A judge model must learn from evidence, not from self-assessment.

findings.defect: A search counted as passed when the tool ran.
findings.cause: The tool's ok was read as the answer's verdict.
findings.fix: Passed only when the answer's check is recorded.

outcome: Processes, judgments and searches each have their set, with who judged and on what evidence.
lessons: Say what a field means before filling it: ok was not passed.
risks: Episodes of stages and team walks are not built yet.
